<!-- pr-reviewer: 92c452b54089449b281adff1f81c88d8776607ed -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One item is open: the screenshots. The code and the tests are good.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes the post gate and the stock simulation.

## What looks good

- The post gate refuses each unsuppressed waterjet operation by name (`crates/app/src/posting_waterjet.rs`). The clause is in `verification_report_by`, and each post path goes through that function (`posting.rs`, `posting_mounts.rs`, `posting_per_op.rs`, `posting_agie.rs`, `script/api.rs`).
- A user post with `serves = ["waterjet"]` gets the same refusal and writes no file.
- The nozzle is not in the stock plan. The sim refuses its verdict by name, as the wire clause does. The not-judged line is visible.
- The waterjet clause adds nothing when the program list cannot be read. The gate names that fault one time.
- The new modules have a provenance line. The decision file has the correct format.
- No `*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**` file and no snapshot PNG changed.

## Results merged with main

Built and tested locally. Trial merge of `92c452b54` with `upstream/main` `6d0381f19`: no conflicts.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 333 steps, 0 failed.
  - The first run stopped before `waterjet_profile`, because a second session moved the checkout to a new trial merge. The tree was the same (`da53a172`). I ran the remaining 27 steps with `--only`. All passed.
  - The plan included `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `catalog_groove_part_off`, `post_not_judged`, `waterjet_profile` (13 passed), `motion suites: lib` and the 9 `ui suites` (`lib` included).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Extra suites run (the diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer):
- `camcraft-app --test golden_cl`: 34 passed. The waterjet CL golden did not move.
- `camcraft-app --test mcp_waterjet`: 1 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test waterjet_machine`: 13 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test cut_recipe`: 20 passed.

Mutations (my own runs, in a throwaway copy of the trial merge):
1. I removed `problems.extend(waterjet::problems(world));` from `posting.rs`. RED: `waterjet_post_gate_names_the_missing_safety_records` and `waterjet_user_post_cannot_bypass_the_safety_refusal` failed. `post_not_judged` stayed green (4 passed).
2. I removed `waterjet::refuse_waterjet_cuts(world)?;` and `|| waterjet::skips(&op)` from `stock_sim.rs`. RED: `waterjet_nozzle_is_absent_from_stock_playback`, `waterjet_verification_reports_the_unjudged_operation` and `waterjet_stock_verdict_is_refused_by_name` failed.
3. The restored tree: 13 passed.

Goldens moved: none. I confirmed this from the diff.

Not run: the light tier and the heavy lanes. No heavy record names this head. The heavy lanes are not a merge condition.

## Requested before merge

1. **Before and after screenshots of the waterjet page are missing.** The PR changes the UI in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/waterjet_page.rs` (lines 15, 85-89 and 114). The body says "Not attached". Put the images on the `pr-screenshots` branch of the fork and link them from the PR body. Do not commit them to the PR branch. Show these three items, before and after:
   - the compensation choice on Geometry ("In control");
   - the zero lead-in consequence on Lead in / Lead out;
   - the tab rows on Passes ("Tab 1 position", "Tab 2 position").

   This needs no code change and no new head.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `docs/decisions/3637-waterjet-safety.md:40` says "When #1882 and #1885 land". #1882 is closed: the post engine has the `JET ON` / `JET OFF` records. The missing part is the operation, which does not write them and has no standoff height. No open issue tracks that part by name. A follow-up issue for it (suggested `P6`, `effort:high`) gives the refusal a clear end condition.
- The waterjet page does not say that posting is refused. The user learns it at the post gate. A one-line note on the page is a possible follow-up (`P7`).
- The viewport stock view now shows the stock uncut for a waterjet operation, as it does for a wire cut. This is correct, but no text on that view says so.
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` has 1668 lines. This PR adds 4. The file was above the 400-line rule before this PR.
- The path note in `crates/motion/src/waterjet/emit.rs:135` still says "(G41/G42)". The issue asked for the UI label only, so this is not a finding.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the missing before and after screenshots. The PR body now links all six PNGs from the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.

- Geometry shows the compensation change to “In control”. Pin: `waterjet_compensation_uses_a_plain_control_label`.
- Lead in / Lead out shows the zero lead-in consequence. Pin: `waterjet_zero_lead_in_names_the_part_edge_pierce`.
- Passes shows “Tab 1 position” and “Tab 2 position”. Pin: `waterjet_tab_position_rows_have_unique_names`.

All three pins failed with the parent page and passed after restoration. The captures use the same egui state and a CPU renderer. This host has no GPU adapter. All temporary capture code was removed.

The PR head stays `92c452b54089449b281adff1f81c88d8776607ed`, as the review requested. Image commit: `e747f9dd9280e24b3312003006fb64853f5f09e6`.

Clippy, catalog and all 34 CL golden tests passed. Quick: 331 of 332 steps passed; UI lib failed seven tests because no GPU adapter is available. Heavy: 103 steps, one unexpected failure in `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`. The body records the failure, five accepted expected failures, and the base refs. No unrelated code changed.

Please re-review the screenshot evidence. The PR remains a draft.
